newsitem.title: USA: Westmoreland benefits hearing set for Wed.
newsitem.headline: Westmoreland benefits hearing set for Wed.

text.p: Westmoreland Coal Co said that a Federal District Court has denied the United Mine Workers of America's request to make the company immediately restart paying 1992 beneficiary expenses.

The UMWA sought an order requiring Westmoreland to temporarily restart the payments after the company stopped making them last week. The company said it did not have the cash or income to meet the obligation, which has been costing Westmoreland about $200,000 a week, company spokeswoman Diane Jones said.
The 1992 UMWA Benefit Plan affects about 1,200 Westmoreland retirees and their dependents.
The Federal District Court in Abingdon, Virginia, will hold a hearing on Wednesday to consider the matter, Jones said.
In the meantime, the court ordered both parties to negotiate a settlement, and to report Tuesday to a magistrate on the status of their negotiations.
